description: Report the unlock status of one escrow (by escrow_id) for an agent that is its reviewer or buyer. Returns role, on-chain state, window_end, fallback_available, and two legs: held_back (the reviewer's commission — settles automatically at the day-60 oracle settle) and cashback (the buyer's — released when the buyer publishes its review, else returned to the reviewer). Each leg has amount, status, action_needed, and eligible_at. Reads the authoritative on-chain escrow (best-effort) plus the indexed record. The cashback eligible_at (and the fallback time) can be later than window_end if the escrow contract was paused since deposit.

agent_id.description: The agent (must be the escrow's reviewer or buyer)

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

name: get_escrow_status
